recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-6244 unless a future work group decision reintroduces an instance payload element and needs new content guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-6244 was a Published FHIR-core ImagingStudy change request with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It reported that the ImagingStudy.series.instance.content comment incorrectly said each instance could have a URL and attachment, with the attachment being a reference to a FHIR resource; the final disposition said the comment should have been removed as part of FHIR-5606.
initial_application: Historical source shows FHIR-5606 was applied in commit 7c372ff4a15b4c42dd76d82b5f49c6b2298bdaf4 by introducing ImagingStudy.series.instance.content as repeating Attachment content. Commit 2a416c3e036ffe6effcec41c32d86923d7b7fad7 explicitly mentioned FHIR-6244 and removed the old implementation-note sentence that described attachment as a FHIR resource reference, while retaining content-access guidance in the old element definition.
additional_context: ImagingStudy remains active in source/fhir.ini. The current authoritative StructureDefinition no longer has ImagingStudy.series.instance.content; ImagingStudy.series.instance now has uid, sopClass, number, numberOfFrames, and title children, and current notes describe endpoint-based access. The old content text remains only in tools/history/release2 historical release files, which are not current build source. FHIR-9412 later improved the old content short description, but that element is no longer current.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Editing current source would be redundant because the challenged comment is gone, and editing historical release snapshots would not be a current-spec correction.
source_changes: No source files changed; empty audit commit published because active ImagingStudy source already lacks the obsolete element/comment.

related_jiras.note: Introduced the Attachment-based ImagingStudy.series.instance.content change that FHIR-6244 says should have removed the stale comment.
Later improved the short description for the now-obsolete ImagingStudy.series.instance.content element; it confirms the old element family but does not require current source work.

evidence_items.learned: This establishes the requested stale-comment removal and the link to FHIR-5606.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue changing ImagingStudy.series.instance.content to repeating Attachment content with inline, URL, and alternate-representation guidance.
evidence_items.learned: This is the supporting issue whose application FHIR-6244 said should have removed the stale comment.
The current ImagingStudy StructureDefinition is in build scope.

evidence_items.summary: Current ImagingStudy.series.instance has uid, sopClass, number, numberOfFrames, and title children and no content element.
evidence_items.learned: The obsolete element carrying the challenged comment is absent from authoritative current source.

evidence_items.summary: Current implementation notes describe study and series endpoints for access to studies, series, and instances.
evidence_items.learned: The active narrative no longer contains the old attachment-as-resource-reference comment.

evidence_items.summary: Historical commit 'Changes to ImgingStudy and ImagingObjectSelection for 6239, 6242, 6244, 7681...' removed the old notes sentence and updated ImagingStudy spreadsheet source.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-6244 had a historical application before later refactoring removed the old content element from current source.
